description: Send a reply to the message, comment or review behind an inbox item, with the reply text in body.message. Sends through the connected account on Instagram (DMs and comments), Mastodon and Google Business Profile reviews; on other platforms the item is marked handled and nothing is sent (sent: false), and an empty message also sends nothing. Returns the sent status and the provider message id when available. Retry-safe: a repeat call with the same idempotency_key returns the original result.

body.description: Optional body override for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

query.description: Optional query overrides for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to operate in: the `id` of a workspace returned by aidelly_list_workspaces. Optional for read operations; required when creating content.

name: aidelly_reply_to_inbox_item
title: Reply To Inbox Item
